BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health insurance policies; and adding a newsection to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) After the effective date of this section, no health carrier maydeliver, issue, or renew a health insurance policy that includes anyadditional coverage mandates, beyond those mandates in effect on theeffective date of this section. (2) The office of the insurance commissioner shall contract for anindependent health care actuarial review of all existing health carecoverage mandates. The first mandate to be reviewed is the requirementto cover every category of health care provider as required by RCW48.43.045.
